# Plugin.Maui.ApiResilience

HTTP resilience for .NET MAUI: retry with jitter, circuit breaker, offline request queue, and automatic bearer token refresh.

Repository: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/Plugin.Maui.ApiResilience
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.ApiResilience
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-api-resilience
Catalog: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/NugetWorld
License: MIT

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+)

Platforms: Android, iOS. Mac Catalyst and Windows are not primary targets.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.ApiResilience

Registration: `UseApiResilience / AddApiResilience` — see README.md.

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- How do I add HttpClient retry and a circuit breaker in MAUI?
- Offline POST queue for mobile
- Automatic bearer refresh on 401

## Do not use when

- The project already standardized on Polly + a custom outbox
- You need a full auth session product — see Plugin.Maui.SecureSession
